title: Molecular Studies on Hereditary Haemorrhagic Telangiectasia Families
brief_summary: This study will examine genes involved in the vascular dysplasia Hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia i(HHT)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Member of family affected by HHT

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable or unwilling to provide informed consent for DNA sample
study_population: Patients with hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia and their families
